title: The Strange Vice of Mrs. Wardh
writer: Eduardo Manzanos, Ernesto Gastaldi, Vittorio Caronia
actors: George Hilton, Edwige Fenech, Conchita Airoldi
plot: Shortly after moving to Vienna, Austria with her diplomat husband, a woman is stalked and terrorized by a mysterious razor-wielding maniac, with people around her getting killed one by one.
